sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Whisk Fork State Upgrade
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition from Capella to EIP-7441 (Whisk), including initialization of Whisk-specific state fields: proposer trackers, candidate trackers, per-validator trackers, and k-commitments.

nodes.label: Capella Beacon State Active
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running with a Capella-format BeaconState, with no Whisk fields.

nodes.label: Check EIP-7441 Fork Activation
nodes.description: Check if state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 AND compute_epoch_at_slot(state.slot) == EIP7441_FORK_EPOCH. Fork epoch must be a multiple of RUN_DURATION_IN_EPOCHS.

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_eip7441
nodes.description: Transform Capella BeaconState to EIP-7441 BeaconState: copy all existing fields, initialize whisk_proposer_trackers, whisk_candidate_trackers, whisk_trackers (per-validator), and whisk_k_commitments.

nodes.label: Initialize Validator Whisk Secrets
nodes.description: For each validator, compute k = get_initial_whisk_k(), derive k-commitment = get_k_commitment(k), and initial tracker = get_initial_tracker(k).

nodes.label: EIP-7441 Beacon State Initialized
nodes.description: The beacon state now includes all Whisk fields: proposer trackers, candidate trackers, per-validator trackers, and k-commitments.

nodes.label: Retroactive Candidate Selection
nodes.description: Select candidates using epoch offset saturating_sub(epoch, PROPOSER_SELECTION_GAP + 1) to avoid seed collision with proposer selection.

nodes.label: Proposer Selection
nodes.description: Populate whisk_proposer_trackers for the upcoming day of proposals.

nodes.label: Current Epoch Candidate Selection
nodes.description: Prepare candidates for the upcoming shuffling phase.

nodes.label: Whisk Proposer Selection Operational
nodes.description: All three selection operations complete; Whisk is fully initialized with proposers and candidates ready.

edges.label: At epoch boundary, check fork conditions
Fork epoch reached and slot aligned
All validators have trackers and k-commitments

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Fork Activation Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints that must hold for the EIP-7441 fork to activate correctly.

nodes.label: EIP7441_FORK_EPOCH Configured
nodes.description: The fork epoch is set in configuration (currently TBD, set to max uint64).

nodes.label: Validate Fork Epoch is Multiple of RUN_DURATION_IN_EPOCHS
nodes.description: Check that EIP7441_FORK_EPOCH % RUN_DURATION_IN_EPOCHS == 0, required for Whisk shuffling alignment.

nodes.label: Fork Epoch Valid
nodes.description: The fork epoch satisfies the multiple constraint.

nodes.label: Fork Epoch Invalid (Constraint Violation)
nodes.description: The fork epoch does not satisfy the constraint; activation would produce incorrect shuffling.

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7441: Whisk Cryptographic Initialization Security
sub_graphs.description: Models the security-critical initialization of Whisk cryptographic material (k values, commitments, trackers) and the trust boundary around get_initial_whisk_k().

nodes.label: Validator Set Known at Fork
nodes.description: The full validator set from the Capella state is available for Whisk initialization.

nodes.label: Generate Initial Whisk k per Validator
nodes.description: Call get_initial_whisk_k() for each validator to produce their secret scalar k used in the Whisk protocol.

nodes.label: Derive k-Commitment
nodes.description: Compute get_k_commitment(k) for each validator, producing a public commitment to their secret k.

nodes.label: Derive Initial Tracker
nodes.description: Compute get_initial_tracker(k) for each validator, producing the initial WhiskTracker from their secret.

nodes.label: Cryptographic Material Committed to State
nodes.description: All k-commitments and trackers are stored in the beacon state, binding validators to their Whisk secrets.

edges.label: Use k to derive public commitment
Use k to derive initial tracker
Store commitments and trackers in state

ambiguities.text: The specification references get_initial_whisk_k() without defining its implementation or entropy source.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume get_initial_whisk_k() is deterministically derived from validator public key and chain state, making it reproducible across all nodes. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The upgrade function transforms 'a Capella BeaconState' but EIP-7441 fork version 0x08000000 suggests it may follow a later fork than Capella.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the spec means the immediately preceding fork's state format (whichever fork precedes EIP-7441 in the final fork schedule). This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot derive a validator's Whisk secret k from the publicly stored k-commitment or tracker.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If k can be recovered from public data, an attacker could predict future proposer assignments, defeating the purpose of Whisk (secret leader election).

implicit_assumptions.description: The three sequential post-upgrade selection operations (retroactive candidate, proposer, current candidate) complete atomically within the state transition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the selections are interrupted or incomplete, the chain could proceed with missing proposers or candidates, causing missed slots.

implicit_assumptions.description: The saturating_sub(epoch, PROPOSER_SELECTION_GAP + 1) offset is sufficient to avoid seed collision between candidate and proposer selection randomness.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Seed collision could allow an attacker to correlate candidate selection with proposer selection, reducing the anonymity guarantees of Whisk.
